extracted.name: Easy Vegetable Cheese Soup
extracted.description: American processed cheese food and milk are blended into a simmering pot of onions, potatoes and celery in boullion.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound processed cheese food (eg. Velveeta), cubed
instruction_lines: In a large pot boil the chopped celery, chopped onion, potatoes, mixed vegetables, bouillon cubes and water until all the vegetables are tender.
Add the Velveeta® milk and butter or margarine. Heat until hot and serve.
